final: WITH country_counts AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS player_count FROM player_college AS pc JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id GROUP BY p.birth_country), overall AS (SELECT SUM(player_count) AS total_count, AVG(player_count) AS average_count FROM country_counts) SELECT SUM(c.player_count) AS total_player_count, AVG(c.player_count * 1.0 / o.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(c.player_count - o.average_count) AS average_excess FROM country_counts AS c CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE c.player_count > o.average_count
